subject.title: Dashboard: apps layer — full-bleed tabs + widget gallery

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-on bundled dashboard apps layer that installs third-party widget bundles, and what storage and dependency-approval boundary must it use before merge?
rationale: The PR changes default startup behavior, dependency graph, persisted runtime state, and browser sandbox/code-distribution boundaries, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or grant dependency approval.

options.title: Pause and narrow after the base stack
options.body: Wait for #101098 and storage/security decisions, then rebase this PR to the full-bleed/gallery delta with dependency approval or removal.

options.title: Accept explicit bundled-surface exceptions
options.body: Maintainers can approve the dependency graph, JSON state exception, and default-on dashboard security model, then require targeted bug fixes and proof before merge.

options.title: Move gallery distribution out of bundled core
options.body: Keep only generic dashboard seams in OpenClaw and route third-party widget discovery/install behavior to ClawHub or an external plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Pause and narrow after the base stack
recommendation.body: Wait for #101098 and storage/security decisions, then rebase this PR to the full-bleed/gallery delta with dependency approval or removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Shakker is the clearest current-main owner signal for adjacent Control UI plugin routing and canonical plugin-state behavior; security approval still needs the appropriate maintainer/security reviewers.
